jobs.title: Principal Program Manager
jobs.description:
Fin , now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity?

We're looking for a Principal Program Manager to join the Strategic Program Management team in San Francisco. This is a senior individual contributor role where you shape how Fin’s highest-priority objectives get set up for success and delivered. Reporting to Senior Manager, Strategic Program Management, you'll work directly with senior leaders across every org to turn ambiguous, high-stakes company goals into programs that deliver on their goals. You'll also raise the bar for how program management works at Fin, building the systems and practices that make the whole team, and those that work with you, better.

What will I be doing?

- Partner directly with execs and senior leadership to define programs of work that enable Fin to hit its highest priority company objectives

- Take a holistic view across programs, connecting the dots back to company strategy and surfacing gaps, misalignment, or opportunities to streamline

- Take ambiguous, high-stakes problems and drive them to clarity - defining the right structure, roles, and decision-making frameworks, often from scratch

- Drive cross-functional decision-making by identifying the right stakeholders, surfacing the information they need and recommendations

- Proactively identify program risks and anticipate change before it happens, driving action to course-correct and maintain momentum

- Set and raise the bar for how program management works at Fin - creating new frameworks, challenging existing processes that aren't working, and feeding learnings back into how the team operates

- Hold people accountable at every level, from workstream drivers to exec sponsors, ensuring progress and ownership across complex, cross-functional programs

- Mentor and develop teammates, making the people around you better and faster

- Evangelize program management across the company - shaping how other teams and orgs think about execution, collaboration, and ways of working

What skills do I need?

- You have 8+ years of experience in program management with a track record of leading large, complex, cross-functional programs in a fast paced AI/SaaS B2B environment with an evolving strategy

- Proven experience working directly with senior level leadership, you’re comfortable engaging with and influencing senior executives and leadership to get to the right outcome

- High ownership and agency, with the ability to manage multiple high-profile, high-visibility programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

- A strategic thinker who connects execution to company strategy, spots gaps across programs, and understands how mission, product, and financial plan tie together

- You are solutions oriented and proactive when it comes to taking action to solve problems and mitigate risks

- You have strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills with a track record of bringing together senior-level viewpoints and driving alignment

- You’re an excellent self-starter with a track record of seamless execution on complex programs with minimal guidance

- You've built and significantly improved program management practices, frameworks, or ways of working at a previous company

- Excellent communicator who can flex between an exec room and a cross-functional working group, adapting style and depth to the audience

- Experience mentoring or developing others, whether direct reports or peers - you make the people around you better

*Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required.

The base salary range for candidates within the San Francisco Bay Area is $189,000-$225,750. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

#LI-Hybrid
Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers . Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Policies

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our  core values .

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.  Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What’s the opportunity?

As a Senior Sales Operations Manager, you will be a strategic and operational partner to Fin’s Sales organization, helping build the systems, processes, reporting, and operating rhythms that enable our go-to-market teams to scale effectively.

You’ll work at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Business Systems, Data Engineering, Marketing, and GTM leadership. You’ll own critical sales operations programs across forecasting, pipeline management, territory and quota planning, compensation, performance reporting, and process optimization.

This is a high-impact role for a systems thinker and commercially minded operator who can move comfortably between detailed analysis, cross-functional program management, and executive-level recommendations. You’ll have the opportunity to improve how Fin’s sales organization operates while helping scale the GTM engine behind one of the fastest-growing AI products in the market.

What will I be doing?

- Own and optimize core sales operations processes, systems, and operating cadences across the sales organization.

- Partner with Sales leadership and Finance to build and maintain forecasting processes, pipeline reporting, quota models, attainment tracking, and performance insights.

- Develop clear, trusted reporting and dashboards that give leaders visibility into funnel health, productivity, conversion, win rates, capacity, and revenue performance.

- Lead territory planning, segmentation, coverage, and capacity analysis to support efficient allocation of sales resources.

- Partner with Finance and Sales leadership on compensation planning, plan administration, performance measurement, and reporting.

- Translate business requirements into scalable solutions across CRM, BI, sales planning, compensation, and other GTM systems.

- Partner with Business Systems and Data Engineering to improve data quality, data models, integrations, automation, and reporting infrastructure.

- Identify and eliminate operational bottlenecks across the sales cycle, including lead routing, opportunity management, approvals, contracting, handoffs, and post-sale transitions.

- Establish and maintain consistent definitions, governance, documentation, and processes for key sales metrics and data.

- Lead complex cross-functional projects from discovery through implementation, including requirements gathering, stakeholder alignment, testing, rollout, and change management.

- Build executive-ready analyses and recommendations that help leadership make decisions about growth, investment, productivity, and organizational design.

- Use AI tools and automation thoughtfully to reduce manual work, improve data access, and increase the speed and quality of sales execution.

- Create scalable operating processes that support growth without requiring linear increases in headcount.

- Act as a trusted advisor to sales leadership on performance trends, operational risks, process improvements, and strategic priorities.

- Support quarterly and annual planning activities, including business reviews, headcount planning, goal-setting, and operating plan development.

What skills do I need?

- 5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, GTM Strategy, Sales Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, or a related field, preferably in a high-growth technology or SaaS company.

- Strong understanding of sales processes, forecasting, pipeline management, quota and territory planning, compensation, and sales performance metrics.

- Experience owning or significantly improving CRM, BI, planning, compensation, or revenue technology systems.

- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and practical recommendations.

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and experience with BI or reporting tools such as Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar.

- Familiarity with Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms; experience partnering with Business Systems or Data Engineering teams is highly valuable.

- Experience designing scalable processes, data governance frameworks, reporting systems, and operational workflows.

- Ability to manage complex, cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

- Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect operational improvements to revenue outcomes.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present recommendations to senior leaders.

- Comfortable working hands-on in the details while maintaining a strategic view of the broader business.

- AI fluency and curiosity about applying AI, automation, and emerging tools to improve sales productivity and operational efficiency.

- High ownership, sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and a bias toward action.

- Comfortable and energized operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where priorities evolve quickly.

*Proof of eligibility to work in the United States is required.

The base salary range for candidates within the San Francisco Bay Area is $162,000-$180,000. Actual base pay will depend on a variety of factors such as education, skills, experience, location, etc. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All regular employees may also be eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).
